steps.code:
# Get all sent transactions this month, handling pagination
all_transactions = []
page = 0
while True:
    batch = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=access_token, direction='sent', min_created_at=first_day, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not batch:
        break
    all_transactions.extend(batch)
    if len(batch) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

print(f"Total sent transactions: {len(all_transactions)}")
# Get unique receiver emails
receiver_emails = set()
for t in all_transactions:
    receiver_emails.add(t['receiver']['email'])
print("Unique receivers:", receiver_emails)
